parameters.description: Words to search for (every word must appear in the subject or body; put a phrase in quotes), plus any of Front's filters, written as name:value with spaces between them, up to 15. is: takes a status: archived, assigned, open, resolved, snoozed, trashed, unassigned, unreplied, waiting (for example 'is:open is:unassigned'). inbox:, tag:, assignee:, participant:, author:, mention:, commenter:, contact: and link: take a Front id, not a name, such as inbox:inb_41w25, tag:tag_13o8r1 or assignee:tea_2thf (find them with 'List inboxes', 'List tags' and 'List teammates'). from:, to:, cc:, bcc: and recipient: take an email address or other handle. before:, after: and during: take a time as a number of seconds since 1 January 1970 UTC, such as after:1748000000, and match any message or comment in the conversation. Filters all have to match, except that repeating from:, to:, cc: or bcc: matches any of the repeated values. Trashed conversations are left out unless you ask for is:trashed. Results come most recently active first. There is no filter for how long a conversation has waited: use 'List unassigned conversations' for that.

front_new_conversation_trigger.description: Runs for each new conversation a customer starts in Front, such as a new email or message arriving in a shared inbox, with its subject, the customer's message, who they are, its inbox, tags and assignee, and a link to open it in Front. It can run only for one inbox. Conversations already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it, and neither do replies or conversations a teammate starts. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.assignee_email: That teammate's email address. Blank when unassigned.
output.assignee_name: The name of the teammate it is assigned to. Blank when unassigned.
output.conversation_link: A link a teammate can click to open the conversation in Front.

output.from_name: The customer's name, such as Jo Lee. Blank if Front has none.

output.inbox_name: The name of the inbox it arrived in, such as Support.

output.message_text: The customer's first message as plain text. Very long messages are cut at 10,000 characters.
output.subject: Its subject line. Blank for a chat or text message.
output.tags: The names of the conversation's tags.

front_new_inbound_message_trigger.description: Beta. Messages that arrived before the workflow was turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
